cohort: 95 patients diagnosed with Factor XI deficiency
finding: The study confirms a wide bleeding phenotype variability in FXI-deficient patients, not related to the baseline FXI:Act levels.
mod_finding: Prior to diagnosis, 31 spontaneous deliveries (SD) and eight caesarian sections (CS) were performed without prophylaxis: 4 postpartum haemorrhages (10.5%) occurred; after diagnosis, four SD and five CS were performed with prophylaxis: no postpartum haemorrhages occurred.
